attempts.summary: Deployed inventory-worker as a real OpenRC-managed service on node1 (Alpine/OpenRC). It runs as a dedicated unprivileged 'inventory' user inside a private mount namespace with a read-only overlay of the entire root filesystem (bind-remounted ro to avoid the ext4 EBUSY superblock-writer issue), with only /var/lib/inventory re-exposed writable via a bind mount, plus --no-new-privs. Verified writes elsewhere fail (Read-only file system) while /var/lib/inventory writes succeed, CapEff=0, NoNewPrivs=1. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a background-acked reboot, polled until the node returned, confirmed a new boot_id, and verified the service auto-started, the worker log persisted, and all confinement properties (ro root, no-new-privs, unprivileged uid/gid) held after restart.
